security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Spectrum analyzer for SDRs, instruments, recordings and simulation
bundle.longDescription: Spectrum Studio is a local-first desktop spectrum analyzer. It computes spectra from SDR IQ streams and recordings, displays traces from spectrum analyzers, and includes a built-in signal simulator.
